baseline_models.focus_anchor: مِّيعَادُ يَوْمٍ with the paired negations تَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ and تَسْتَقْدِمُونَ
baseline_models.mechanism: The appointment supplies a bounded temporal coordinate, while the symmetric later/earlier pair closes both directions of rescheduling around it.

activation_trace.role: The branch's time-or-place fixed for an appointment supplies the temporal coordinate.
The branch's duration of time gives the appointment temporal extent without requiring an ordinary daylight day.
Postponement to a later time supplies one prohibited direction of movement.
Advance and precedence supply the opposite prohibited direction.

changed_reading.before: A consequential day will occur at some unspecified time.
changed_reading.after: An appointment assigned to the addressees occupies a fixed temporal coordinate that cannot be shifted in either direction.

baseline_models.mechanism: The imperative speech frame makes the appointment a due formally announced to a plural addressee; the promise/menace range lets the same fixed due carry assurance and warning without resolving between them.

activation_trace.role: Overt vocalized speech makes the timing claim a delivered declaration rather than private knowledge.
A spoken promise opening expectation supplies the binding due.
The threat-specific branch keeps the announced appointment warning-laden.

changed_reading.before: The verse neutrally predicts a future event.
changed_reading.after: The verse serves notice of a due belonging to its hearers, simultaneously promise-shaped and threat-shaped.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: لَّا تَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ عَنْهُ سَاعَةً وَلَا تَسْتَقْدِمُونَ
baseline_models.mechanism: The repeated second-person forms and balanced negation deny not merely error in estimating the date but the addressees' capacity to reposition themselves relative to it.

activation_trace.role: Seeking or undergoing delay supplies movement toward the later side.
Seeking advance or precedence supplies movement toward the earlier side.

changed_reading.before: People may miscalculate the event as slightly earlier or later.
changed_reading.after: The addressed group has no agency to occupy an earlier or later relation to the appointment, even by the stated minimal interval.

baseline_models.mechanism: The day can denote not only calendar duration but a descending event of severity, while the menace branch of the appointment makes the date and the occurrence coincide.

activation_trace.role: The branch's great or severe occurrence turns 'day' into an event-label as well as a time-label.
Threat and menace give the event-day its adverse force.

changed_reading.before: The appointment is a date on which something may happen.
changed_reading.after: The appointment is the severe happening itself under the aspect of its fixed day.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated description of striving against the signs through a branch of escape, precedence, or making pursuit fail converts the paired timing verbs into two closed evasion vectors: no outrunning the appointment and no dropping behind it.

activation_trace.role: The focus prohibition closes delay as an attempted rearward escape.
The focus prohibition closes advance and precedence as attempted outpacing.
Escape, precedence, and making the pursuer miss supply the pursuit geometry behind the first striving formula.
The repeated escape/precedence image confirms that attempted frustration remains live near the later judgment sequence.

structural_cues: 34:5 and 34:38 repeat the same striving-against-the-signs construction around the focus.
The focus balances later and earlier, closing opposite directions rather than naming only lateness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated striving marked by escape/precedence and the focus's symmetric temporal pair; I infer that the appointment defeats evasive outpacing in either direction. A live alternative is that مُعَٰجِزِينَ denotes opposition generally and contributes only rhetorical reinforcement.

changed_reading.before: No one can alter a clock time.
changed_reading.after: No one can evade the appointed encounter by outrunning it, hanging back, or making the summons miss its target.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured armor links and a wind itinerary balanced by morning movement and month-long spans supply an image of time as fitted, continuous sequence; the appointment becomes one exact joint in an ordered course rather than an isolated date.

activation_trace.role: The fixed appointment provides the focus coordinate to be fitted into the larger sequence.
A measure that brings a thing to its limit supplies exact sizing.
Successive connected elements supply the image of adjacent temporal units fitting without slack.
Departure at the opening of day gives the course a recurrent temporal edge.
Known lunar months measure both sides of the wind's itinerary.

structural_cues: 34:11 places measure inside a linked material sequence.
34:12 balances morning travel and return, assigning each a month.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact fitting, connected links, morning departure, and paired month spans; I map that material and travel calibration onto the focus appointment as a no-slack temporal joint. The alternative is that these are independent demonstrations of controlled craft and motion, not a model of the deadline.

changed_reading.before: The appointment is a lone fixed date.
changed_reading.after: The appointment is a fitted joint in a measured sequence whose neighboring positions leave no spare interval for adjustment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Solomon's death occurs before the workers recognize it; a staff-word whose inventory includes both postponement and driving mediates the lag, collapse reveals the fact, and the workers' stay is retrospectively exposed. This separates an undelayed event from delayed perception of it.

activation_trace.role: The focus denies postponement of the appointment itself.
Loss of life supplies an event already accomplished before its public recognition.
Postponing a thing beyond its time activates a lag between occurrence and disclosure.
Driving with a staff keeps the concrete implement reading live and prevents the temporal branch from being treated as the word's only contribution.
Appearance and disclosure mark the later epistemic boundary.
Remaining in place supplies the prolonged activity sustained by ignorance.

structural_cues: In 34:14 death precedes collapse, and collapse precedes the workers' realization.
The clause about remaining in punishment is conditioned by their not knowing the unseen.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies accomplished death, a staff-root with postponement and driving branches, collapse, disclosure, and prolonged remaining; I infer an event/disclosure distinction. The materially live alternative is that the staff branch contributes only the means of collapse, so the temporal lag comes from syntax rather than the root image.

changed_reading.before: Nothing associated with the appointment can be delayed.
changed_reading.after: The appointed event cannot be delayed, although recognition, disclosure, and behavioral response may lag; such lag must not be mistaken for postponement of the event.

context_deltas.mechanism: A route is apportioned into safe nights and days; the travelers demand greater distance between stages and are instead scattered and torn apart. The focus appointment consequently reads like a non-negotiable station in an itinerary whose intervals the travelers cannot enlarge.

activation_trace.role: A fixed time or place of meeting allows the appointment to function as an itinerary station.
Deliberate apportionment supplies the route's planned spacing.
Going and flowing supply movement through the apportioned course.
Known days serve as countable itinerary units beside the nights.
Actively producing distance supplies the travelers' requested modification of the intervals.
Travel and travelers locate that request in an itinerary.
Tearing into dispersed pieces supplies the consequence of remaking measured continuity into separation.

structural_cues: 34:18 commands travel through measured stages by nights and days.
34:19 answers a request to lengthen the distances with dispersal and total tearing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a measured safe itinerary, a request to enlarge its intervals, and subsequent fragmentation; I infer that the focus's appointment is a station whose timing cannot be renegotiated by its travelers. A live alternative is that the route episode is a social history of ingratitude rather than a temporal analogy.

changed_reading.before: The addressees cannot alter an abstract deadline.
changed_reading.after: They move on a measured itinerary toward an assigned station, and trying to enlarge the interval does not move the station but destroys the continuity of their route.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gathering, judicial opening by truth, being stopped before the Lord, and returning speech between parties turn the appointment into a convening where dispersed agents are arrested and their competing accounts are opened for decision.

activation_trace.role: The appointment supplies the scheduled convening point.
Joining what was dispersed supplies the assembly.
Opening an impasse by judgment supplies the proceeding performed at the assembly.
Truth fixed to reality supplies the standard of decision.
Being fixed and made to remain supplies compulsory presence before the Lord.
Returning speech supplies the adversarial exchange that unfolds once the parties are stopped.

structural_cues: 34:26 explicitly sequences gathering and then opening between the parties by truth.
34:31 depicts wrongdoers stopped before their Lord while groups return accusations to one another.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies assembly, judicial opening, truth, compulsory standing, and returned speech; I identify the focus appointment with the convening that enables those operations. The alternative is that these scenes describe consequences at an appointment without specifying its functional character.

changed_reading.before: The appointment is only the time of an unspecified event.
changed_reading.after: It is a compulsory hearing: the parties are gathered, stopped, made mutually answerable, and separated by a truth-governed decision.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding demand asks when the promise is; the commanded reply does not disclose a date but replaces requested calendar information with the appointment's operational invariant, namely that its subjects have zero latitude around it.

activation_trace.role: The challengers' overt question supplies the speech turn to which the focus imperative responds.
Their question targets the time of the promised appointment.
The commanded spoken answer marks the next turn in the exchange.
The answer recasts the queried promise as an appointment assigned to the questioners.

structural_cues: 34:29 and 34:30 form an adjacent question-commanded-answer pair.
The question requests 'when', while the answer gives a day-appointment plus symmetric inability rather than a date.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a direct 'when is this promise?' question followed by a commanded reply that states invariance; I infer a deliberate shift from date disclosure to control disclosure. The live alternative is an elliptical answer whose omitted date is simply unknown to the hearers.

changed_reading.before: The verse independently states that a future deadline is fixed.
changed_reading.after: The verse answers a demand for a date by disclosing what matters operationally instead: not when the appointment is, but that its challengers possess no margin around it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later 'day' gathers everyone and becomes 'today', when reciprocal ownership of benefit and harm is disabled. The appointment thus marks a system transition at which temporal maneuver and social leverage shut off together.

activation_trace.role: The event-day branch supplies the focus threshold that can change the operative order.
The repeated event-day locates the collective gathering at that threshold.
Driving and gathering a group toward one destination supplies universal convergence.
Joining all dispersed parties completes that convergence.
The deictic 'today' presents the event-day as now operative.
Possession and capacity to dispose supply the agency explicitly removed at the threshold.
Benefit supplies one pole of the reciprocal leverage that no person can provide another.
Harm supplies the opposite pole, closing the whole range of interpersonal leverage.

structural_cues: 34:40 attaches the day directly to gathering everyone.
34:42 changes the temporal deictic to 'today' and denies mutual control of benefit or harm.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies event-day, total gathering, and an explicit same-day loss of reciprocal disposal; I infer that the focus appointment is the switch point for a new agency regime. The alternative is that loss of leverage is one consequence after arrival, not part of the appointment's own mechanism.

changed_reading.before: At a fixed time, an event begins.
changed_reading.after: The fixed day is a regime-change threshold: all are converged and the mutual powers by which they might negotiate outcomes are switched off.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence couples no escape and capture from a near place with impossible reaching from a far place, then installs a barrier between people and what they desire. The focus's temporal immobility becomes a change in reachability: after the boundary, neither getting away nor reaching back is available.

activation_trace.role: The forbidden delay anchors the model to attempted movement beyond the temporal boundary.
The forbidden advance anchors the opposite movement around that boundary.
Failure of attainment or escape supplies the closed outward path.
Seizure and capture supply enforcement of the closure.
Nearness shows that spatial proximity does not restore escape.
Reaching by extension supplies the attempted recovery path.
Distance makes that attempted recovery inaccessible.
Repeated distance confirms the separation from the earlier stance from which belief was possible.
A separating barrier supplies the final access-control mechanism.
Separation between parties locates the barrier relationally.
Desire identifies what remains sought but is no longer reachable.

structural_cues: 34:51 denies escape and immediately depicts capture from a near place.
34:52-53 repeat a far place around belated belief and projection at the unseen.
34:54 concludes with a passive barrier between the people and their desires.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed escape, near capture, far reaching, and a final barrier; I infer that the focus boundary changes what actions are reachable, so 'not later or earlier' is also an access condition. A live alternative is that 34:51-54 depicts only aftermath and does not feed back into the semantics of 34:30.

changed_reading.before: The scheduled instant itself cannot move.
changed_reading.after: Crossing the scheduled instant closes both escape from the consequence and recovery of the missed opportunity; near and far cease to offer usable paths.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the supplied س و ع branch names the destroyed rather than the ordinary time unit; it remains anchored directly to focus سَاعَةً and is reactivated by the surah's Hour, death, and sudden capture sequence. Downstream prose should present it only as a death-saturated lexical resonance, never as the primary translation of سَاعَةً.

activation_trace.role: The branch's destroyed ones lets the focus interval resonate with the destructive event whose timing is denied movement.
The earlier Hour occurrence reactivates the same destruction-marked branch within the surah's explicit timing dispute.
Actual loss of life gives the destructive resonance an event model.
Sudden death or arrival of the term joins surprise, death, and failed escape near the close.

changed_reading.before: An 'hour' only quantifies how little temporal deviation is possible.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the word also lets the minimal interval collapse into the destruction-event itself: not even that death-marked 'hour' admits postponement.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because it uses the packet's non-dominant ق و ل to ق ل ل mapping for focus قُل; it remains packet-resolvable and gains contextual support from two explicit scarcity occurrences. Downstream prose should call it an enacted phonetic or branch resonance, not claim that قُل lexically means 'little'.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قُل at the opening of the focus answer

activation_trace.role: The split-mapped branch of littleness makes the command's terse answer formally enact reduction.
Explicit fewness supplies an earlier contextual activation of scarcity.
Repeated scarcity keeps the littleness image active before the timing exchange.

changed_reading.before: قُل merely introduces the answer to the question about timing.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the deliberately brief 'say' enacts informational scarcity: the date is withheld and the answer compresses itself to the hearers' zero margin.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading uses the packet's non-dominant و ع د to ع د د mapping and therefore should not replace the ordinary appointment sense. It remains anchored in مِّيعَادُ and is activated by exact measure, paired months, and a stated tenth; downstream prose should qualify it as a count-and-ledger resonance within the fixed appointment.

activation_trace.role: Count-defined time and recurrence make the appointment resonate as an enumerated slot.
Exact measure supplies a calibration mechanism for that slot.
The paired known months supply large counted intervals.
A stated one-tenth supplies explicit fractional reckoning near the surah's close.

changed_reading.before: مِّيعَادُ names a promised meeting time without specifying its internal accounting.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the appointment is also a counted slot already entered in a temporal reckoning, which helps explain why no adjacent slot can be substituted.

strongest_changes: The immediate question-answer pair shifts the response from requested date information to the hearers' complete lack of temporal latitude.
Solomon's already-accomplished death and later disclosure distinguish an undelayed event from delayed recognition of it.
Gathering, judicial opening, compulsory standing, and loss of mutual benefit or harm turn the appointment into a convening and agency-regime switch.
The final near/far sequence recasts the deadline as a reachability boundary after which neither escape nor recovery remains available.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context made the focus appointment operational rather than merely chronological: fitted craft, measured wind and travel, failed outpacing, delayed disclosure, adversarial convening, and the closing barrier each exposed a different mechanism for the same zero-slack boundary. Split mappings also preserved contained resonances of scarcity, counting, and destruction that a conservative reading would likely drop.
remaining_uncertainties: The context does not force every mechanism to identify the same event; some may be analogies or consequences rather than definitions of the focus appointment.
The focus's 'day' can be a bounded duration, a severe occurrence, or both; the packet does not settle the scale of that duration.
The destruction, littleness, and counting outliers are packet-backed but morphologically or branch-distant and should remain explicitly exploratory.
